hlt.title: Site health
hlt.sub: One line each for customer problems, the server, speed, the site audit and the smoke test. Green is fine, yellow needs a look, red is wrong, grey has nothing to judge yet.
hlt.noServer: No server reports reach this copy of the shop (a developer machine), so the server, speed and smoke lines stay grey.

problems.notYet: Not recording yet. The privacy-safe problem recorder comes next and fills this line.

server.noReport: No report from the server's health check yet.
server.late: The server's health check is {min} minutes late.
server.worker: The background worker has stopped (no heartbeat).
server.workerNever: The background worker has not started yet.
server.ok: Every service is up and the background worker is alive.

speed.noReport: No speed reading from the server yet.
speed.late: The last speed reading is {min} minutes old.
speed.noAnswer: The home page did not answer the server's check.
speed.slow: The home page took {ms} ms (yellow above {limit} ms).
speed.ok: The home page answered in {ms} ms.

audit.notYet: Not running yet. The site audit's checklist runner fills this line.

smoke.never: No smoke test has run yet.
smoke.late: The last smoke test is {h} hours old (it runs after every deploy and every night).

note.k6: First load measurement (k6): 95% of requests within {p95} ms.

card.d: Only how the lines are judged; nothing on the server changes.
card.monitorStaleMinutesHelp: The server checks itself every minute.
card.siteSlowMsHelp: The server's own alert uses its own limit.
card.smokeStaleHoursHelp: It runs after every deploy and every night.

err.STALE: Someone else changed this; it shows their values now.
err.forbidden: You do not have permission to change this.
err.unauthorized: Your sign-in has ended — please sign in again.
err.other: That did not save. Please try again.

hlt.readOnly: You can see these limits; changing them needs the settings permission.
